note: PROTOCOL.md §2.2. Local rungs are served by Ollama (the Mac for smoke and qualification, the piz server's container over an SSH tunnel for the paper presets: --ollama-url). The hosted rungs use the Responses API with the user's key, read from the environment variable named here. H2's id is provisional until the hosted campaign's start, when a key probe pins the cheapest nano tier the key serves (T32's user run); its list price is then recorded here by an amendment, never typed into a result. `think`: the local rungs state the Qwen models' default (thinking on) so that every side sends the same value (T31 review 2, nit 12; D-358); each record carries the value sent per model call; the hosted route takes none.
